registerNotMeasured: Not measured. This file is a cognate record, not a register pass: there is no scripts/l10n/detectors/it.js and nothing here measured the formal/informal register of the it bundle, so selfcheck must not report a register verdict for it.
scopeNote: COGNATE RECORD for it. Every value in l10n/it.json that was byte-identical to the English source has been reviewed one by one: each is either recorded below with a written reason, or was replaced by a real translation in the same pass. The list is therefore closed - a NEW identical value in it means a new judgement, not an existing licence.

cognates.3: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.30: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.Account: Established loan; the standard Italian term (l'account).
cognates.Avatar: International term, spelled and used identically in Italian.
cognates.ConfigSet: Apache SOLR's own object name; used untranslated in Italian SOLR documentation.
cognates.ConfigSet:: Apache SOLR's object name plus a colon; nothing translatable.
cognates.DSAR: Acronym (Data Subject Access Request); used untranslated in Italian privacy practice.
cognates.Deck: Nextcloud app name; kept untranslated in every finished locale.
cognates.Driver: Established loan; Italian technical writing keeps 'driver'.
cognates.Email: Established loan; the standard Italian term (l'email).
cognates.Escalation: Established loan; 'escalation' is the standard Italian term in service management.
cognates.Excel (.xlsx): Product name plus a file extension; nothing translatable.
cognates.File: Established loan; the standard Italian term (il file).
cognates.Host: 'Host' is the Italian technical term too.
cognates.Host *: 'Host' is the Italian technical term; the asterisk is a required-field marker.
cognates.ID:: Acronym plus a colon; Italian puts no space before a colon.
cognates.Id: The same acronym in the casing the source uses.
cognates.Multitenancy: Kept untranslated in Italian technical writing; this bundle already renders it so.
cognates.N/A: Not-applicable abbreviation, kept as-is in every locale of this app.
cognates.No: Same spelling and meaning in Italian (no).
cognates.OpenCorporates: Name of an external data source; a proper noun.
cognates.OpenDocument (.ods): Format name plus a file extension; nothing translatable.
cognates.OpenRegister: The application's own name; a proper noun.
cognates.Password: Established loan; the standard Italian term (la password).
cognates.Pattern (regex): 'Pattern' and 'regex' are both kept untranslated in Italian developer UI.
cognates.Provider: Established loan; the standard Italian term (il provider).
cognates.Quota: Same spelling and meaning in Italian (la quota).
cognates.RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation acronym; used untranslated in Italian technical writing.
cognates.RBAC: Access-control acronym; used untranslated in Italian technical writing.
cognates.Repository: Established loan; the standard Italian term for a code repository.
cognates.Schema: Same spelling and meaning in Italian (lo schema).
cognates.Slug: URL-slug term, kept untranslated in Italian CMS and API tooling.
cognates.Test: Established loan; the standard Italian term (il test).
cognates.UUID:: Acronym plus a colon; Italian puts no space before a colon.
cognates.Url: The same acronym in the casing the source uses.
cognates.Webhook: Established loan; the standard term in Italian technical UI language.
cognates.X-Custom-Header: value\nAuthorization: B: Literal example of raw HTTP headers; header names are protocol tokens.
cognates.X-Custom-Header: value\\nAuthorization:: Literal example of raw HTTP headers, with the newline written out; protocol tokens.
cognates.file: Same loan, in the casing the source uses.
Literal example of an API-key prefix; not prose.
cognates.in {register}: 'in' is the same preposition in Italian; the remainder is a placeholder.
cognates.myapp: Literal example value for an app identifier; not prose.
cognates.objectType: object\naction: created: Literal example of a YAML/header payload; the keys are protocol tokens.
cognates.objectType: object\\naction: created: Literal example of a YAML/header payload, with the newline written out; protocol tokens.
Literal example of an API-key prefix; not prose.
Literal example of an API-key prefix; not prose.
cognates.{count} email: 'email' is invariant in Italian, so the plural form is spelled the same; the rest is a placeholder.
cognates.{property} - {other}: Two placeholders and a separating dash; nothing translatable.
cognates.{title} in {register} / {schema}: Only 'in' is translatable and it is the same preposition in Italian.
